text: Another way to harmonize the first chakra is to get a plant at home. Sprout and plant a seed. For example, an avocado pit sprouts easily. Of course, you are free to choose any plant you like. You can even buy an already sprouted small plant. The main thing is to care for it with your own hands, water it, wipe its leaves, observe how it grows, periodically transplant it into a larger pot... This seems domestic, but the first chakra is exactly like that. In a month a subtle sense of stability will appear, anxiety will decrease, and your home will become more “warm” and alive.
